decision.summary: The Federal Reserve kept the federal funds rate target range at 0 to 1/4 percent.

changes.quote: The Federal Reserve is committed to use its full range of tools to support the U.S. economy in this challenging time and thereby promote its maximum employment and price stability goals.
changes.explanation: The Fed shifted its wording from being prepared to use its tools to being fully committed to supporting the economy in a challenging time.

changes.quote: The Federal Open Market Committee is taking further actions to support the flow of credit to households and businesses by addressing strains in the markets for Treasury securities and agency mortgage-backed securities.
changes.explanation: The Fed added specific measures to ease strains in crucial credit markets.

changes.quote: The Federal Reserve will continue to purchase Treasury securities and agency mortgage-backed securities in the amounts needed to support smooth market functioning and effective transmission of monetary policy to broader financial conditions.
changes.explanation: Purchases of government bonds and mortgage securities will continue in whatever amounts are necessary.

changes.quote: The Committee will include purchases of agency commercial mortgage-backed securities in its agency mortgage-backed security purchases.
changes.explanation: The Fed expanded its asset purchases to include commercial mortgage-backed securities.

changes.quote: In addition, the Open Market Desk will continue to offer large-scale overnight and term repurchase agreement operations.
changes.explanation: The Fed committed to continuing large-scale repo operations to supply liquidity to short-term markets.

tone_quotes.quote: The Federal Reserve is committed to use its full range of tools to support the U.S. economy in this challenging time and thereby promote its maximum employment and price stability goals.

The Federal Open Market Committee is taking further actions to support the flow of credit to households and businesses by addressing strains in the markets for Treasury securities and agency mortgage-backed securities.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 14.87% APR costs about $61.96 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 0.76% and moved -16 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 3.36% would fall by about $26.40 a month.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 3.5%, and employers added an average of 209k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 2.3% over the past year (February 2020); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 1.7%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 2.8% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved -9 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved -2.93%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved 0.95% on the day.

card.whats_next: The statement signals that the Federal Reserve will continue its aggressive market interventions and massive asset purchases to stabilize the financial system. According to the educational forecast model, the probability of holding rates at the next meeting is 84%, with a 4% chance of a cut and a 12% chance of a hike.

citations.detail: Effective March 23, 2020, the Federal Open Market Committee directs the Desk to undertake open market operations as necessary to maintain the federal funds rate in a target range of 0 to 1/4 percent.
